name: Date Masamune
source:
The Suzaku of Heaven from the realm of Ryōen

Young patriach of Date clan. 26 years old
A cheerful entertainer who is positively gaudy
He is very popular, respected by his citizen and retainer due to his charisma.
As a military commander, he is determined and dare to choose a tough decision  


[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara04_datemasamune.html]official website[/url]]
